about: I'm **Qasim Raza Malik**, a **full-stack software engineer and data analyst** from **Abbottabad, Pakistan**, working with **React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python and SQL**.

I'm an **AI & Backend Developer at [Digital Experts Dev](https://digitalexperts.dev)**, building backend services and REST API integrations for AI-enabled web apps. Before that I was a **Full Stack Developer Intern at Axelliant**, and as a **freelance frontend developer at Lytnetwork** I delivered **30+ live business and e-commerce websites**.

On the data side, I've worked remotely in **data roles at Blip, Stellar Tech (data engineering) and Scentbird (BI / data analyst)**, and I built the forecasting dashboard for **ForecastPro AI**, an e-commerce sales-prediction project.

I hold a **BS in Computer Science** from **Abbottabad University of Science and Technology (AUST)** and I'm doing an **MS in Artificial Intelligence at COMSATS**. I also co-run **[Primeura Digital Solutions](https://primeura.com)**.
